result.freshness_policy: live: every search reads the workspace through the td CLI; no index, no cache

binary.description: Path to the td executable. Resolved on PATH when omitted.

labels.description: Restrict this source to issues carrying this label. Configure at most one; td intersects repeated labels.

max_candidates.description: Cap on candidates returned by one search.

max_term_probes.description: Cap on how many query terms are probed. Each probe is one td invocation; a short multi-word query costs one more for the whole phrase, and every search costs one for the workspace listing.

replay.description: Directory of recorded td output, relative to the source's location. When set, no process is spawned and every invocation is answered from the recording, which is what lets a committed evaluation pack exercise this adapter.

statuses.description: Restrict this source to issues in these td statuses.

timeout_ms.description: Per-invocation timeout. Composes with the request deadline; the sooner wins.

types.description: Restrict this source to these td issue types.

workspace.description: Workspace identity carried in every locator. Defaults to the base name of the location. Set it when two configured workspaces would otherwise share a name.
